name: Black-capped Chickadee
desc: Black-capped Chickadee (Poecile atricapillus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 32 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The black-capped chickadee is a small, nonmigratory, North American passerine bird that lives in deciduous and mixed forests. It is a member of the Paridae family, also known as tits.
